analytical_coverage.scope_note: Late Part V confrontation and epilogue (GO-U027–GO-U028), with separately attributed retrospective Harmony history used to test the claimed protective outcome. Review covers the comparative analysis, not a complete novel reading or the separate monograph. Later history is not Clavis’s contemporaneous knowledge.

notes: Deliberate authorship, guilt and reversal of the protected population coexist with imposed civilian costs and private self-protection. Distinguish narrated riots and deaths from projected civil war/genocide. Connection to the later Maelstrom is a bounded cross-work inference, not proof of sole responsibility for every subsequent event.

analytical_coverage.scope_note: Late Part V confrontation (GO-U027) and the legacy of the withheld English grammar in GO-U028, as interpreted in the two-novel comparative study. This is bounded analysis of protective priorities, admitted tradeoffs, grief and political answerability; not a review of the separate whole-novel monograph or primary witness.

notes: Particular care and acknowledged sacrifice coexist; refusal to call his choice justice does not supply authorization from affected people. Claims about controlled linguistic effects remain fictional and attributed. Shared author or thematic similarity does not establish technological identity across works.
